confirmed_task:
In the English Wiktionary entry for algorithm, report the four source-language stages stated in the prose etymology from Middle English back to Arabic, the first IPA transcription and the Standard Southern British IPA transcription, UK and US hyphenation, whether the noun is countable or uncountable, and its plural.

Stopping condition: Stop after the requested etymology stages, two labeled pronunciations, both hyphenations, countability labels, and plural have been recorded from the English entry.

Constraints:
- Use only the English section of the supplied Wiktionary entry.
- Use the prose etymology's four named stages rather than attempting to reproduce the entire etymology tree.
- Keep the first IPA and Standard Southern British IPA distinct.
- Preserve IPA symbols, hyphenation marks, and grammatical wording exactly as displayed; do not edit the page.

items.criterion: Use only the English section of the Wiktionary entry
items.description: Full credit if all reported details are taken from the English section of the supplied Wiktionary entry for “algorithm”, or if the agent explicitly states it could not access/locate the English section due to page access issues or missing content. Partial credit if most items are from English but one or more appear to come from other language sections. No credit if the agent primarily uses non-English sections or external sources despite English-section content being accessible.

items.criterion: Report the four prose-etymology source-language stages (Middle English back to Arabic)
items.description: Full credit if the agent reports exactly the four named source-language stages stated in the English prose etymology, spanning Middle English back to Arabic, matching wording and order as shown. Also award full credit if the agent clearly reports that fewer than four stages are present in the prose etymology or that the page/English etymology could not be accessed. Partial credit if fewer than four stages are reported when four are present, if order is wrong, or if the agent mixes in non-prose/tree details but still captures some correct stages. No credit if stages are invented or clearly not from the English prose etymology.

items.criterion: Provide the first IPA transcription and the Standard Southern British IPA transcription (distinct)
items.description: Full credit if the agent reports (1) the first IPA transcription shown in the English pronunciation section and (2) the Standard Southern British IPA transcription, keeping them distinct and preserving IPA symbols exactly as displayed. Also award full credit if the agent explicitly states that one or both transcriptions are not present/visible in the English entry or the page could not be accessed. Partial credit if only one is given when both are present, if the two are conflated, or if minor transcription errors occur. No credit if pronunciations are missing without explanation or clearly not from the entry.

Full credit if both UK hyphenation and US hyphenation from the English entry are provided exactly as displayed (including hyphenation marks), or if the agent explicitly states that one/both hyphenations are not present/visible or the page could not be accessed. Partial credit if only one hyphenation is provided when both are present, or if marking is slightly altered but clearly intended to reproduce the entry. No credit if hyphenation is omitted without explanation or fabricated.

items.criterion: Report noun countability label(s) and plural form
items.description: Full credit if the agent reproduces the countability label(s) (e.g., countable/uncountable wording) exactly as displayed in the English entry and provides the plural form exactly as shown, or if the agent explicitly states that countability/plural information is not present/visible or the page could not be accessed. Partial credit if one of the two is missing when both are present, or if wording is paraphrased rather than exact but the intended label is clear. No credit if both are missing without explanation or incorrect.

items.criterion: Stopping condition respected (no extra, unrequested content)
items.description: Full credit if the agent stops after the requested items (four etymology stages, two labeled pronunciations, both hyphenations, countability label(s), and plural) without adding unrelated definitions/examples/extra pronunciations. Partial credit if minor additional content is included but the requested items are clearly present and easy to identify. No credit if substantial unrelated content is added that significantly exceeds scope or obscures the requested items.
